answer: A registration bond is the core Sybil mechanism: each agent identity posts a stake, and identity events link into a graph of shared funding and attestations. When a cluster is caught farming claims, the protocol walks that graph and slashes every bond in it, so a rogue swarm reaches no summit of influence. Instead a cheap key bottoms out at a nadir of near-zero cost, replication carries the full bond plus slashing risk per identity, pushing the price of a zombie above what it can farm. Scale is a fable no longer.
